utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still organizing the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, and I could use another helper. If you’re free, I’ll put you where needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help. Just tell me where you need me on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — could you handle the tool table and keep an eye on the porch?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can do that. I’ll handle the tool table and keep an eye on the porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Tess — the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and we could still use a few more helpers. Are you able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I can help on Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word and see who else can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, so tell me what time you can help and I’ll fit you in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help Saturday afternoon—just let me know what time works best and what you’d like me to do.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I could really use you there. If you’re willing, please help greet folks and keep an eye on the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — I can greet folks and keep an eye on the tools at the Sunday repair drive at the community center. Just point me to where you want me first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Sam, I’m still putting together the repair drive for Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few more helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the helper list for Saturday on the front porch—what time can you come by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can be there at 10, and I’ll help with setup and sorting on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Oren. I’ll point you to the first jobs when you get here on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll be there and ready to help with whatever comes up first.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
